scenarios.name: unknown-venue-is-ignored

scenarios.name: suspect-reentry-upstairs-keeps-baseline

scenarios.name: suspect-reentry-at-entrance-takes-new-baseline

scenarios.name: late-reentry-takes-new-baseline
scenarios.description: Exit and enter 3 hours later: a new visit with a new baseline, even if the phone is upstairs (no way to tell).

scenarios.name: no-barometer-stays-mall-level

scenarios.name: escalator-ride-does-not-flicker

scenarios.name: switch-malls-without-exit

scenarios.name: app-restart-inside-keeps-baseline

scenarios.name: app-restart-during-capture-recaptures

scenarios.name: drift-is-corrected-while-standing
